/media/jumpscare-face.jpg.title: FRAME FROM A WIPED PHONE
/media/jumpscare-face.jpg.description: Factory reset lied. This scream-face sat in unallocated space. Timestamp: three minutes after the owner vanished. The audio lasts longer than the body did.

/media/crt-scream.jpg.title: THE TV THAT LEARNED A FACE
/media/crt-scream.jpg.description: Motel CRT broadcast a woman on no channel. Guests woke with her face burned into the glass. Dental match: missing clerk.

/media/static-face.jpg.title: STATIC IS A CROWD
/media/static-face.jpg.description: Slow the noise. Teeth. A name. Jane Doe with eyelids cut off so she could keep watching.

/media/nv-silhouette.jpg.title: NIGHT VISION EMPTY HOUSE
/media/nv-silhouette.jpg.description: Silhouette every night. Night sixteen: realtor gone. Silhouette waves.

/media/closet-eyes.jpg.title: WHAT WAS IN THE CLOSET
/media/closet-eyes.jpg.description: Breathing behind coats. Found nude from the waist down, eyes on the closet. Footprints start inside the drywall.

/media/stair-hand.jpg.title: THE HAND ON THE STAIRS
/media/stair-hand.jpg.description: Pale hand from below. Blood trail goes UP. Something dragged him toward it.

/media/mirror-double.jpg.title: MIRROR LAG
/media/mirror-double.jpg.description: You finish twice — once in flesh, once in glass. The glass doesn’t stop.

/media/hall-entity.jpg.title: ENTITY IN THE HALL
/media/hall-entity.jpg.description: Livestream. Chat saw it first. Scream cut the feed. Afterimage burned into the sensor.

/media/cemetery-open.jpg.title: GATE LEFT OPEN
/media/cemetery-open.jpg.description: 3:33 inside the cemetery. Wrists opened at a child’s grave. Empty grave was full by morning.

/media/forest-eyes.jpg.title: EYES BETWEEN TREES
/media/forest-eyes.jpg.description: Tip-line photo: I KEPT ONE. Eyes match no animal on record.

/media/hospital-shadow.jpg.title: WARD C SHADOW
/media/hospital-shadow.jpg.description: Oxy night shift. Human bite marks. Badge fused into teeth in the autoclave.

/media/flooded-basement.jpg.title: THE WATER KEPT RISING
/media/flooded-basement.jpg.description: Three bodies on the heater. Water 4% blood. Pipe never burst.

/media/playground-fog.jpg.title: FOG ON THE PLAYGROUND
/media/playground-fog.jpg.description: Laughter becomes chewing. Man walked out without a tongue.

/media/attic-mirror.jpg.title: ATTIC MIRROR SALE
/media/attic-mirror.jpg.description: Previous owner died mid-orgasm. The mirror finishes for you.

/media/dining-presence.jpg.title: SEAT FOR THE THING
/media/dining-presence.jpg.description: Extra place setting. Guest never used the door.

/media/void-door.jpg.title: DOOR THAT SHOULD NOT OPEN
/media/void-door.jpg.description: Plans say wall. Tenants say door. Ends in your childhood bedroom.

/media/archive_2.jpg.title: SATURN
/media/archive_2.jpg.description: He eats what he fathers. The painting sweats when the room is quiet.

/media/archive_4.jpg.title: THE NIGHTMARE
/media/archive_4.jpg.description: Incubus on her chest. Viewers wake with weight on their ribs and someone else’s breath.

/media/commons_1.jpg.title: JUDITH
/media/commons_1.jpg.description: She holds the head like a trophy. The blood in the paint is still sticky in infrared.

/media/commons_2.jpg.title: VAMPIRE LOVERS
/media/commons_2.jpg.description: Munch’s kiss that drains. Couples who hang it report bite bruises they didn’t give each other.

/media/commons_3.jpg.title: ORLOK STANDING
/media/commons_3.jpg.description: 1922. He doesn’t blink on film because he doesn’t need to. The still moves if you look away.

/media/commons_4.jpg.title: OSSUARY PILE
/media/commons_4.jpg.description: Femurs stacked like lumber. One skull faces the camera every photo no matter the angle.

/media/commons_5.jpg.title: PARIS CATACOMBS
/media/commons_5.jpg.description: Tourists who whisper their names into the bone walls hear them whispered back wrong.
